On 27 GST-with-stage parts the stored 'at' timestamp is not the bill date: either it is a later posting time, or the part was re-billed by the refresh. Its due_on equals the stage bill's due date. Examples: BK-2627-2829 Brickwork part at 2026-11-17, due_on 2026-08-31 (bill 16 Aug); BK-2526-3159 at 2026-04-16, due 2026-03-02. Ageing is right (it uses due_on), but any screen showing 'billed on' from 'at' would show a date after the due date. On BK-2526-3143/3136 the instalments themselves carry 45-day due dates and the parts follow them. Main agent: confirm the intended bill-date field.
